audit.whatIsWrong: Two chart rows disagreed across layers: content win[0]=Orianna / full phases[0].side=Skill, and content win[3]=Brand / full phases[3].side=Skill. The packet levelChart agrees with the content layer on both.
audit.why: Level 1 Orianna wins on autos plus her stacking passive because Sear cannot stun a target that is not already ablaze. At 4-5 Brand has the full Pillar of Flame into Sear chain, which is his kill spike.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side = Orianna, phases[3].side = Brand, with phases[3].why rewritten to describe Brand's kill combo instead of Orianna's Dissonance control.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes carried an unsourced magnitude ("Luden's makes Q-W a third of a health bar") and no Brand spike at all.
audit.why: The kit gives no damage fractions. Brand's real spike curve is Sear falling from 8s to 6s across ranks and Pyroclasm at 100/90/80.
audit.corrected: Spike line rebuilt on Sear's rank-5 6s cooldown and the level 6 Shockwave-versus-Pyroclasm trade.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text, content.late and wants.you[1] all told the reader to Shockwave a clump so that Brand's Pyroclasm bounces through it, as though Brand's AoE would help Orianna.
audit.why: Pyroclasm bounces up to 5 times off Brand and nearby enemies — its targets are Orianna's own team. Gathering enemies with Command: Shockwave clusters Brand's side for Orianna's team to punish; it does nothing for Brand. The advice as written points the reader at the wrong side of the fight.
audit.corrected: Shockwave gathers his side for your follow-up; Pyroclasm's five bounces need YOUR side clumped, so engage grouped and defend spread.

audit.why: Sear only stuns a target that is already ablaze, so the dodge that decides the trade is Pillar of Flame (900 range, delayed) or Conflagration (625), not the Q itself. Sear also out-ranges Orianna's Command: Attack, 1050 to 815 — she cannot win a pure poke war, only a wave-contact one.
audit.corrected: Stated explicitly in breakdown.early and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it, and dosFull[2].d invented a "fifteen-second" Sear.
audit.why: Sear is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6, Pillar of Flame 10/9.5/9/8.5/8, Conflagration 13/12/11/10/9. Nothing in Brand's kit is on fifteen seconds.
audit.corrected: Real per-rank numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns and the do's/don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string and dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string, both pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed — dontsFull[2] is titled "Burn R defensively when E already answers" but explained ball positioning.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to answer their own titles using Command: Protect's 9s and Shockwave's 110s.

notes: The biggest defect here was directional, not cosmetic: three separate fields (spikes[3].text, content.late, wants.you[1]) told the reader to gather a clump so Brand's Pyroclasm would bounce through it — but Pyroclasm's bounce targets are Orianna's own team, so the advice pointed at the wrong side of the fight. Also worth flagging for the whole champion: Sear's 1050 range beats Command: Attack's 815, so any Orianna page that says she 'out-ranges' Brand is wrong; she wins wave contacts, not poke wars. Chart: rows 0 and 3 disagreed between layers and were aligned to the packet/content reading, with phases[3].why rewritten to match the flipped verdict. Left alone: tradeGood/tradeBad (quoted verbatim by breakdown.trading and report[3].t, so a one-sided edit desyncs the page), breakdown.mid and breakdown.late (Orianna-generic rather than Brand-templated, and nothing in Brand's kit gave a same-length replacement).
